title: Huatli | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about Magic: The Gathering's dinosaur-riding knight, with the soul of a poet: Huatli.

paragraphs.text: A renowned Warrior Poet from Ixalan, Huatli is a master of mounted warfarewith the ability to summon dinosaur alliesand lead them in devastating cavalry strikes. After spending many years trapped on her home plane by a magical artifact, Huatli was only recently freed to explore her powers as a Planeswalker. However, she has already proven her courage and prowess defending the innocent from some of the Multiverse’s deadliest threats. Huatli hopes to return home with stories of a larger universethat will enrich the lives of her people on Ixalan.
